description: This file contains the implementation of a standalone Orleans silo host, including the main entry point, process monitoring, and shutdown handling logic.

classes.name: StandaloneSiloHost
classes.description: Contains the main entry point for the Orleans standalone silo process, including process monitoring and shutdown logic.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Asynchronous main method that initializes and runs the silo, handles process monitoring, and manages shutdown.

methods.name: MonitorParentProcess
methods.description: Monitors a parent process by its process ID and exits if the parent process terminates.

methods.name: ListenForShutdownCommand
methods.description: Starts a background task to listen for a shutdown command from standard input and cancels the token source when received.

methods.name: WhenCancelled
methods.description: Extension method that returns a task which completes when the provided cancellation token is canceled.
